name: a_face_is_named_by_a_point
why: BRIEF R12 (25/10/2026). A mate took its faces by direction only, and among the faces that look the same way the largest: on 26P000007 «up» took the bottom of the channel (598.7 mm2) instead of the face to mate (396.9 mm2), and a curved face could never be named, so concentric and tangent were refused. A face can now be named by a point of the assembly, {"point_mm": [x, y, z]}, planar or curved. Geometry: C1 is a cylinder Ø20 x 30, its box centred on the origin, so its axis is the y axis, its side passes through [10, 0, 0] and its top is at y 15. C2 is a cylinder Ø10 x 20 inserted with its box centre at [40, 20, 0]: its axis is at x 40, its side passes through [45, 20, 0], its bottom is at y 10.
defect_caught: A point carried into the part with the transform the wrong way round (it finds no face, or another one); a curved face that is still refused; a point on no face taken as the nearest one; concentric between two faces by direction that is not refused before touching anything.

expect.why: concentric is possible again with a curved face named by a point

expect.tolerance_why: the pin's axis on the shaft's: x 40 to 0, y and z as they were

message_includes: wants at least one curved face
no face of the component passes through

expect.tolerance_why: the pin's bottom on the shaft's top, y 15
